rungs.title: Junior Systems Administrator
rungs.summary: Runs servers, networks and the everyday IT estate.
rungs.knowledge: Learning the basics of systems administrator work and the organisation's language.
rungs.delivery: Completes small, well-defined tasks with close guidance.
rungs.leadership: Asks good questions and keeps people informed of progress.

rungs.title: Systems Administrator
rungs.summary: Developing: An established performer who works independently and builds relationships.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the core systems administrator methods, tools and standards well enough to work unaided on routine work.
rungs.delivery: Delivers agreed work reliably and knows when to ask for help.
rungs.leadership: Communicates clearly with colleagues and starts to build working relationships across teams.

rungs.title: Senior Systems Administrator
rungs.summary: Career: A high-level performer who leads pieces of work and others rely on.
rungs.knowledge: Deep knowledge across systems administrator work, including the harder cases and how they connect to other functions.
rungs.delivery: Owns pieces of work end to end and delivers them to a high standard.
rungs.leadership: Leads small pieces of work, coaches newer colleagues and influences decisions.

rungs.title: Lead Systems Administrator
rungs.summary: Advanced: A leading performer who runs significant work and shapes how others do it.
rungs.knowledge: Broad and deep knowledge that others come to for answers; keeps the practice up to date.
rungs.delivery: Runs significant work, balancing cost, risk and quality, and sets how it is done.
rungs.leadership: Leads people or projects across the organisation and represents the function to senior leaders.

rungs.title: Head of Systems Administrator
rungs.summary: Expert: A recognised expert whose judgement the whole organisation relies on.
rungs.knowledge: A recognised authority whose judgement the organisation relies on, inside and outside it.
rungs.delivery: Accountable for outcomes across a large area; makes the calls that set direction.
rungs.leadership: Shapes strategy with the executive team and builds the next generation of leaders.
